programme.desc: Fariz mengikuti gerak geri Tokwan dan mencari Ain hingga di kedai. Ain berpura-pura tidak mengenali Fariz. Dalam diam, Ain terluka dan terlalu merindui Fariz. Sementara itu, Fadzlan dan Rohana merancang untuk menyatukan Fariz bersama Rania yang turut sama memendam perasaan pada Fariz. Apakah Fariz akan bersetuju?

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rohana desak Fariz agar berkahwin dengan Rania. Bagaimanapun Fariz menolaknya dan bertegas walau apa cara sekalipun, dia akan tetap berkahwin dengan Ainnura. Dalam waktu yang sama, dalam usaha untuk mendapatkan nombor telefon Ainnura, Fariz sanggup ke pejabat Ainnura, bagaimanapun Iqram tidak setuju kerana bimbang rahsia Ainnura adalah bekas isteri Fariz akan terbongkar. Dalam waktu yang sama, Ilah berusaha dengan pelbagai cara agar Ainnura tidak rapat dengan Fariz.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Bayangan Emilia
programme.desc: Rita berpindah masuk ke banglo Ungku Mahmud dan mula merasai akan kehadiran roh yang seperti tidak senang dengan kehadirannya disitu. Apakah misteri di sebalik rumah banglo tersebut?

programme.title: Oh Speak English Please
programme.desc: Kisah Sally anak remaja moden yang merasa malu dengan ibunya kerana tidak pandai berbahasa Inggeris dan berketrampilan agak kekampungan. Lakonan Rozita Che Wan dan Zahirah MacWilson.

programme.title: Striker Hati Ayah
programme.desc: Sofia susah untuk memilih antara dua calon, Raf atau Noah. Lalu meminta pendapat ayahnya, Adam. Kini dua lelaki tersebut terpaksa memenangi hati ayah Sofia, seorang peminat fanatik bola.

programme.title: Gebu Gebu Manis
programme.desc: Kisah Hamdi dan Dolah yang memulakan perniagaan dodol tetapi sering disabotaj oleh Amira yang cemburu dengan perniagaan dua orang sahabat ini.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Bayangan Emilia
programme.desc: Rita berpindah masuk ke banglo Ungku Mahmud dan mula merasai akan kehadiran roh yang seperti tidak senang dengan kehadirannya disitu. Apakah misteri di sebalik rumah banglo tersebut?

programme.title: Oh Speak English Please

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. But a lack of food isn't all that's wrong, there are scars on his face and body that suggest he's been through a hard youth. To try and piece together the dog's history Joe needs all the information he can gather.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt is asked by a local cat charity to treat a litter of tiny abandoned kittens. They're so weak, it's touch and go whether any of them will survive.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt is asked by a local cat charity to treat a litter of tiny abandoned kittens. They're so weak, it's touch and go whether any of them will survive.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa. In Hong Kong they've been working closely with local SPCA as they try to combat their ever growing stray dog population. As part of an exchange programme with the UK that has been running for over a decade, Inspector Herchy Boal has come to witness and learn about those problems first hand so the two charities can work together on future solutions.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Bougie Badass Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don’t you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is throwin’ down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
programme.desc: Don’t let the line of trick-or-treaters or the candy corn overload scare you out of the kitchen this Halloween. Frankie’s got tricks up his sleeve to make simple yet wicked good treats for everyone at the party to enjoy. All while saving some dough.

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: An Eggplant Extravaganza
programme.desc: Eggplant: A fruit you didn’t know was a fruit. Often underrated and overlooked, Frankie shows us how to shop for and cook this filling, delicious, cost-effective, and versatile ingredient. The days of mushy, bitter eggplant will be long gone.

programme.title: Plant-Based Budget Meals
programme.desc: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally and shopping the bulk aisle to save money on produce. It’s nutritious and great for the planet. Win-win!

programme.title: The Weekly Struggle Budget
programme.desc: Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don’t have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

programme.title: Turn Up For Tomatoes
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to prepare tomatoes fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve them so you can enjoy their freshness throughout the year.

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: Date night doesn’t have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget. That special someone will love it!

programme.title: Lunches for Work
programme.desc: A big way to save money is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. You'll be saving money, and you might even be more productive at work after a nutritious homemade lunch!

programme.title: Party for Pennies
programme.desc: Frankie makes three dishes for a party of four, that when combined, are cheaper than just one meal out for brunch. Then, it's a taco party for five people for only $20!

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ.

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Origins to Originals
programme.desc: From roast chicken to smash burgers to hot sauce, Stephanie Izard meets three different chefs putting their own California-inspired spin on food from their heritage by remixing traditional recipes that center local, fresh ingredients.

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Home Cooking
programme.desc: From a homerun Greek dinner party series to a backyard that’s become a gourmet deli to a Burmese pop up running out of an apartment kitchen, Stephanie Izard meets cooks finding ingenious ways to serve mouth-watering food out of their houses.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays
programme.desc: In this episode, you don’t even need to turn on your oven! From a jaw-dropping cake hack, to fried biscuit donuts, you won’t believe what you can do with pre-made desserts from the supermarket. Mia will show hacks and great tips for any home-baker!

programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World

programme.desc: Sandwiched between Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia, Laos is a destination often overlooked by tourists. Marko and Alex are uncovering the hidden gem of Vientiane, the capital city, to see what goes on in this sleepy town beside the Mekong River.

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: Wrap it Up!
programme.desc: First, Frankie packs a one-two punch of bargain and nutrition with butternut squash in three nostalgic, old school dishes. Then he shows you how to prep portable wraps at home for easy, peasey lunches.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Spice Is Nice
programme.desc: Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends. Bonus: Frankie also tackles a monster challenge with our favorite monster guest!

programme.title: Rent Week
programme.desc: It’s the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge is looking pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and teaches us how to better prep for this time of the month.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans
programme.desc: Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making super tasty recipes. Beans are the gift that keeps on giving, so don’t be scared to eat too many. Remember, they’re good for your heart.

programme.title: Mushroom Mania
programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. He makes three no-fuss appetizers that are cheaper, healthier, and tastier than subpar game day take out. So gather around with friends and cheer on your favorite teams. Or just eat. Both are a win.

programme.title: Root-to-Stem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to use whole vegetables, from root-to-stem, which means no food goes to waste. Learn how to use vegetable stalks you would normally throw away. Root-to-stem cooking: less waste, more food, and more nutrition. Frankie’s favorite.

programme.title: Bacon My Heart
programme.desc: Versatility is important. These three items - bacon, eggs, and a whole chicken - will feed you a plethora of delicious meals... and for cheap!

programme.title: Instant Gratification
programme.desc: Everyone loves carbs! Endlessly versatile, cheap, and super filling - Frankie shows you tricks for pasta, pizza dough, and delicious, easy ramen meals that aren't soup.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. He makes three no-fuss appetizers that are cheaper, healthier, and tastier than subpar game day take out. So gather around with friends and cheer on your favorite teams. Or just eat. Both are a win.

programme.title: Root-to-Stem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to use whole vegetables, from root-to-stem, which means no food goes to waste. Learn how to use vegetable stalks you would normally throw away. Root-to-stem cooking: less waste, more food, and more nutrition. Frankie’s favorite.

programme.title: Bacon My Heart
programme.desc: Versatility is important. These three items - bacon, eggs, and a whole chicken - will feed you a plethora of delicious meals... and for cheap!

programme.title: Instant Gratification
programme.desc: Everyone loves carbs! Endlessly versatile, cheap, and super filling - Frankie shows you tricks for pasta, pizza dough, and delicious, easy ramen meals that aren't soup.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans
programme.desc: Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making super tasty recipes. Beans are the gift that keeps on giving, so don’t be scared to eat too many. Remember, they’re good for your heart.

programme.title: Mushroom Mania
programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: Wrap it Up!
programme.desc: First, Frankie packs a one-two punch of bargain and nutrition with butternut squash in three nostalgic, old school dishes. Then he shows you how to prep portable wraps at home for easy, peasey lunches.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Today, we're going on an adventure to the Mediterranean! We're making our way to the cool blue waters of the sea to find the best recipes from all over the region. Every segment, we'll present a few and then show you our favorite. Opa!

programme.title: Veggies Veggies Everywhere
programme.desc: Today, we'll be showing you how to use green veggies in every meal, including snacks! We hope you're ready, because Mom wants you to eat all the veggies on your plate!

programme.title: Pizza Time
programme.desc: Today we've got pizza all day for you: in the morning, in the evening, literally any time you want! Not only will we share some great recipes but we will let you know which ones are our favorites too. What are we waiting for? Let's get to the pizza!

programme.title: Crock Pots and Steamers
programme.desc: Today, we'll be checking out some incredible recipes that can be made in a crock pot or a steamer! From soups to regular meals, even right down to some unconventional ideas, we've got it all. Plug in those crock pots, it's time to get steamy!

programme.title: Less Stress Holidays

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Over the Top Holiday Cakes
programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Pizza Slice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill throws a pizza party with her delicious homemade pies! She creates a sweet and savory pie with spicy pepperoni & pineapple, a tangy BBQ chicken pizza, a grandma deep dish pie with mozzarella & chorizo, and an herby salad flatbread.

programme.title: Plantains and Rice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month with her mom’s recipes as well as some of her own. She’ll whip up a coconut coquito cocktail, Cuban-style black beans, a garlicky arroz con pollo with sofrito, and some salty and sweet plantains.

programme.title: Moroccan Lamb with Sangria, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill welcomes the coziness of fall with some fabulous flavors & dishes including Moroccan lamb with dates & harissa, fall sangria with apples & amaretto, garlicky rice pilaf, roasted root vegetables, and crispy cucumber salad. It’s fall y’all!

programme.title: Doing Brunch Right, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill brings big brunch vibes with her favorite weekend dishes including NY-style bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich with black pepper bacon, Maryland-style Old Bay crab cake benedict, coquito French toast bites, and a berry-ful Aperol spritz!

programme.title: Tacos and Margaritas, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill hosts a heavenly girls night in, complete with sweet potato tacos with roasted corn salsa, carne asada tacos with orange & spice, and crab and shrimp enchiladas with chili verde. She tops it all off with a fabulous margarita station.

programme.title: Weeknight Noodles

programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks classic Grandma style pizza including homemade dough, sauce and more. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Rustic Comfort Pastas
programme.desc: Perfect Pantry Puttanesca is packed with more flavor than you could ever hope for; a Rustic Pork Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever makes Bolognese: and a Vegetarian Mushroom Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever eats meat.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.desc: Cheese can be really expensive. Frankie teaches us how to cook with more affordable cheese swaps, and we learn how to stretch cheese in a dish so it can be the star without breaking the bank. Bonus: Frankie teaches how to make cheese at home!

programme.desc: It's time for some summer fun! Don't worry, we got you covered with some of the best Summertime BBQ around. Fire up your grills and bust out those tongs, because it's time for more Tastemade's Recipe Rundown!

programme.title: Spooky Season
programme.desc: The fog is rolling in, which means it's time for the spooky season! But don't you worry, because you'll be able to keep those ghosts and skeletons happy with all the spooky eats and scary treats in this episode of Tastemade's Recipe Rundown!

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Frankie prepares a Valentine’s Day dinner for under $15. Why go to a crowded restaurant for an overpriced prix-fixe menu when you can prep a simple yet decadent romantic meal at home? It’ll be sweet, it’ll be aphrodisiacal, and it’ll be sexy cheap.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.title: Cheesin'
programme.desc: Cheese can be really expensive. Frankie teaches us how to cook with more affordable cheese swaps, and we learn how to stretch cheese in a dish so it can be the star without breaking the bank. Bonus: Frankie teaches how to make cheese at home!

programme.title: Meat: More Bang For Your Buck
programme.desc: It's time to reduce the cost of meat on your grocery bill. Frankie shows us which cuts of meat provide the most bang for our buck, and equally as important, how to cook them for optimal flavor.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E08 - Operation Warm Springs
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E10 - Weathered and Worn
programme.desc: The brothers come up with a strategy and start approaching the bull. Halfway there, the bull gets up and starts walking toward them. It turns away just a moment before Casey can aim behind its shoulder.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E03 - Glacier Gold
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his son Kael are underneath a huge glacier, metal detecting for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E09 - Operation Moonshine
programme.desc: Montana game wardens try to catch suspects who illegally kill animals. Also, one of the wardens gets a chance to pause from enforcing hunting rules and goes on a mule deer hunt for himself.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E01 - Best Moments Part 1
programme.desc: Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer look back on some of the best moments from the first two seasons of Dropped. They discuss their most unforgettable solo hunts and how the show has changed over time.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E02 - Best Moments Part 2
programme.desc: Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer look back on some of the best moments from the first two seasons of Dropped. They chat about behind-the-scenes stuff no one has seen and give a sneak peek into what's coming up in Season 3.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Venture into the Mexican seaside state of Veracruz in the south-west of the country and admire the unbelievable colours of locally grown orchids. Find out how vanilla is grown and discover how brown sugar is made. To top things off, witness an extraordinary ritual. Later, we will visit the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. The three islands are relatively small but are inhabited by some remarkable animals including sea turtles, friendly rays and other types of fish as well as fascinating blue iguanas.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E05 - Burnt River
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are sluicing in Eastern Oregon, looking for gold.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E06 - Golden Flight
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his son Kael, are dredging in Anchorage, trying to find some gold for Cindy's birthday gift.

programme.desc: Ivan Carter works to save a key elephant from ivory poachers near Africa's famous Kruger National Park.

programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, was incredibly enchanting and unforgettable, leaving a lasting impact like no other woman of her era. programme.title: Dropped - S03:E01 - Best Moments Part 1
programme.desc: 兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗回顧了《Dropped》前兩季的一些最佳時刻。他們討論了自己最難忘的單獨狩獵經歷，以及節目隨著時間的推移而發生的變化。.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: Nuestro viaje en busca de increíbles milagros de la naturaleza comienza en las Islas Canarias. Lanzarote es de origen volcánico. La actividad volcánica creó un paisaje fantástico, similar al de Marte. En Gran Canarias seremos testigos de una cosecha tradicional de un cultivo que desde aquí se ha llevado al resto del mundo: la caña de azúcar. Terminaremos este episodio en la provincia marroquí de Gulemin, hogar de una tribu nómada cuyos compañeros inseparables son los camellos.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Adéntrese en el estado costero mexicano de Veracruz, al suroeste del país, y admire los increíbles colores de las orquídeas cultivadas en la zona. Descubra cómo se cultiva la vainilla y cómo se elabora el azúcar moreno. Como colofón, asista a un extraordinario ritual. Más tarde, visitaremos las Islas Caimán, en el Caribe. Las tres islas son relativamente pequeñas, pero están habitadas por algunos animales extraordinarios, como tortugas marinas, simpáticas rayas y otros tipos de peces, así como fascinantes iguanas azules.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E05 - Burnt River
programme.desc: Esta semana en Fiebre del Oro Tom y su hija Kia buscan oro en el este de Oregon.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E10 - Operation Big Horn
programme.desc: 你曾經好奇被查扣的獎杯動物會發生什麼嗎？今天我們會告訴你。加入遊戲監管者，與他們一起關注涉及大角羊的狩獵活動。弗拉特海德湖在7月4日的慶祝活動中充滿了節日氣氛。讓我們確保它保持安全。.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E03 - Dropped And Dragging
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱西·基弗（Chris and Casey Keefer）兩兄弟在阿拉斯加的荒野中開始了另一場冒險。他們正在探索一個十多年來未被獵殺的河流系統，因為那裡的掠食者。旅程開始得很慢，兄弟倆花了更多時間拖著裝備，而不是漂流在河上，周圍是一片充滿灰熊的地方。.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E04 - Death In The Water
programme.desc: 尋找成熟的駝鹿開始時，兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗沿著河流向下移動，但當他們與一隻巨大的母灰熊相遇時，他們得到的遠超過他們的預期。.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Hoy visitaremos tres extraordinarios rincones de Europa en busca de los milagros de la naturaleza. Para empezar, nos adentraremos en la región austriaca de Salzburgo. Una zona famosa por sus Alpes y las montañas de Tauern, pero también por ser el lugar de nacimiento de Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Después, nos trasladaremos al extremo suroccidental del viejo continente, a la región portuguesa del Algarve. Para terminar, admiraremos Córcega, la isla francesa de la belleza.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E06 - Naturally Miraculous
programme.desc: En las selvas tropicales de las Seychelles encontramos una fauna y flora extraordinarias. Después, a Mauricio. Donde el símbolo de la cruel y desconsiderada colonización de África es el extinto pájaro Dodo. Concluimos el episodio de hoy en el corazón mismo de África, en el único lugar del planeta donde viven gorilas de montaña, parientes cercanos de los humanos. El país es la República Democrática del Congo y la provincia que visitaremos es Kivu del Sur.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E07 - Stanislaus River Bottom
programme.desc: With the drought in California, Tom and his daughter Kia sail down the Stanislaus River, in search of gold that would otherwise be too deep to find underwater.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E08 - Desert Mine Shafts
programme.desc: Tom y Kia se encuentran en el desierto explorando antiguos pozos mineros.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E03 - Death in the Water
programme.desc: Ivan Carter revela las duras decisiones de África cuando investiga el asesinato de un hipopótamo.

programme.desc: With the drought in California, Tom and his daughter Kia sail down the Stanislaus River, in search of gold that would otherwise be too deep to find underwater.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family
programme.desc: 這是新皇家家庭的第一年，威廉王子和凱特迎來了一個男孩。.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: Se calcula que hay aproximadamente 8,7 millones de especies diferentes de animales en la Tierra. Cada una de ellas ha desarrollado técnicas y habilidades de supervivencia únicas, específicas y a menudo mortales. ¿Cómo elegir un favorito entre un abanico tan amplio de criaturas espectaculares y hermosas?

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E01 - The Hills Have Fangs
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig te guiará por algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig explora las cordilleras costeras del sur de California en busca de la supertóxica serpiente de cascabel del Pacífico Sur.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E02 - Blue Water Savages Part 1
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E03 - Blue Water Savages Part 2
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Milagros de la Naturaleza ha viajado a los cuatro rincones de la Tierra - echamos la vista atrás a la asombrosa variedad de destinos visitados - cada uno de ellos ofrece vistas extraordinarias e impresionantes combinadas con historias dramáticas y una belleza sobrecogedora.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E05 - Alaska Caribou Part 2
programme.desc: En las profundidades del territorio de Alaska, Laramy caza caribúes hasta que un grave accidente con el Hawken pone en entredicho toda la cacería.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E06 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: ¿Podrá Laramy sobrevivir a las duras condiciones del territorio de los alces? Con un fallo de encendido y un nuevo manto de nieve sobre las montañas, la tarea de capturar un alce para el invierno se hace cada vez más difícil.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E07 - Blacksmith Show
programme.desc: Forjar sus propias herramientas era una valiosa habilidad para los montañeses. Laramy nos muestra cómo fabrica su propio equipo.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E08 - Idaho Elk
programme.desc: Con una etiqueta en el bolsillo, Laramy se lanza a las montañas de Idaho a la caza del esquivo alce.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E01 - The Hills Have Fangs
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig te guiará por algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig explora las cordilleras costeras del sur de California en busca de la supertóxica serpiente de cascabel del Pacífico Sur.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E02 - Blue Water Savages Part 1
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E03 - Blue Water Savages Part 2
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Milagros de la Naturaleza ha viajado a los cuatro rincones de la Tierra - echamos la vista atrás a la asombrosa variedad de destinos visitados - cada uno de ellos ofrece vistas extraordinarias e impresionantes combinadas con historias dramáticas y una belleza sobrecogedora.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E05 - Alaska Caribou Part 2
programme.desc: En las profundidades del territorio de Alaska, Laramy caza caribúes hasta que un grave accidente con el Hawken pone en entredicho toda la cacería.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E06 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: ¿Podrá Laramy sobrevivir a las duras condiciones del territorio de los alces? Con un fallo de encendido y un nuevo manto de nieve sobre las montañas, la tarea de capturar un alce para el invierno se hace cada vez más difícil.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E07 - Blacksmith Show
programme.desc: Forjar sus propias herramientas era una valiosa habilidad para los montañeses. Laramy nos muestra cómo fabrica su propio equipo.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E08 - Idaho Elk
programme.desc: Con una etiqueta en el bolsillo, Laramy se lanza a las montañas de Idaho a la caza del esquivo alce.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E11 - Operation Rogers Pass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿遊戲管理員布賴恩·戈利（Bryan Golie）幫助一名在森林中受傷的獵人。與此同時，其他管理員追踪一些試圖跳過檢查站的獵人，導致意想不到的結果。.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E05 - Rising Waters
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer siguen avanzando río abajo, y a medida que se acerca la época de apareamiento de los alces, deben confiar más en pescar, cazar patos y recolectar bayas. Una enorme tormenta de lluvia de Alaska golpea, trayendo grandes desafíos para su éxito.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer are back at it, catching fish for dinner and getting closer to being able to leave. But things get tense when a grizzly bear wanders too close to their campsite, putting both brothers in danger!

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia es un país de innumerables y fascinantes paisajes naturales. Empezaremos en el altiplano, parando en el lago salado más grande del mundo. Después, descenderemos unos miles de metros por la carretera de la muerte hasta la provincia de Los Yungas. Y luego a orillas del lago Titicaca, el lago navegable más alto del mundo.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, la región letona de Kurzeme, las provincias georgianas de Kakheti y Svaneti, parecen tener muy poco en común. Se encuentran en África, Europa y en la frontera entre Europa y Asia, respectivamente. Kakheti y Svaneti forman parte de Georgia, pero son muy diferentes entre sí. Entonces, ¿dónde está la conexión? ¿En qué se parecen estas regiones?

programme.desc: Tom y Kia buscan en el desierto el tesoro perdido de Pata de Palo.

programme.desc: Es verano en Alaska y Tom y Kia aprovechan las 24 horas de luz.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: 紀錄片《卡米拉女王？」更深入地探討了卡米拉·帕克·鮑爾斯，涵蓋了她的歷史、生活以及未來的方向。它集中於她與查爾斯王子的長期關係。該片還探討了卡米拉在查爾斯王子和戴安娜王妃婚姻中所扮演的角色的戲劇性。.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E12 - Operation Elk Dummy
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲管理員在全州設置假麋鹿以試圖抓捕潛在的偷獵者。.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E07 - Salmon Island
programme.desc: Ahora que la mayor parte de las aves acuáticas se han dirigido más al sur para migrar, los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer están poniendo su esfuerzo en la pesca para obtener las calorías que necesitan. Están regresando río abajo después de empacar el campamento, enfocándose en un área que creen tiene varios alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E08 - Log Jammed
programme.desc: 當兄弟們接近一部分滿是駝鹿的河流時，他們面臨著一堆問題。他們必須找到繞過的方法，並把東西搬過一堆巨大的原木，這可能會破壞他們的獵遊，可能將他們推向一部分他們未準備好的河流。.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: En este episodio visitamos dos rincones diferentes de nuestro planeta. Aunque separados por miles de kilómetros, espiritualmente son parientes cercanos. En primer lugar, Etiopía, en África Oriental, diseccionada por el Gran Valle del Rift africano y considerada por muchos la cuna de la humanidad. A continuación, un paraíso en la Tierra: Jamaica.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners
programme.desc: Es un gran año para el campamento minero de Cripple River en Nome Alaska. El equipo está muy ocupado y los participantes ya están encontrando algunos de los mayores yacimientos de oro de la historia reciente.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E12 - One Dredge: Tons of Gold
programme.desc: Tom lleva un par de años dragando un lugar en Arctic creek. Ahora es el momento en que él y Kia van a abrir el agujero con la esperanza de encontrar algo de oro en serio.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars

programme.desc: 當兄弟們接近一部分滿是駝鹿的河流時，他們面臨著一堆問題。他們必須找到繞過的方法，並把東西搬過一堆巨大的原木，這可能會破壞他們的獵遊，可能將他們推向一部分他們未準備好的河流。.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: En este episodio visitamos dos rincones diferentes de nuestro planeta. Aunque separados por miles de kilómetros, espiritualmente son parientes cercanos. En primer lugar, Etiopía, en África Oriental, diseccionada por el Gran Valle del Rift africano y considerada por muchos la cuna de la humanidad. A continuación, un paraíso en la Tierra: Jamaica.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners
programme.desc: Es un gran año para el campamento minero de Cripple River en Nome Alaska. El equipo está muy ocupado y los participantes ya están encontrando algunos de los mayores yacimientos de oro de la historia reciente.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E12 - One Dredge: Tons of Gold
programme.desc: Tom lleva un par de años dragando un lugar en Arctic creek. Ahora es el momento en que él y Kia van a abrir el agujero con la esperanza de encontrar algo de oro en serio.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga una operación de caza furtiva en el mercado negro africano.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: 紀錄片《卡米拉女王？」更深入地探討了卡米拉·帕克·鮑爾斯，涵蓋了她的歷史、生活以及未來的方向。它集中於她與查爾斯王子的長期關係。該片還探討了卡米拉在查爾斯王子和戴安娜王妃婚姻中所扮演的角色的戲劇性。.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E12 - Operation Elk Dummy
